description: This file defines the 'Image' class within the 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Tool' namespace. The class provides functionality related to image processing, specifically resizing images and caching resized images for use within the OpenCart admin panel.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Represents image processing functionalities such as resizing and caching images within the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes an image to the specified dimensions, caches the resized version, and returns the URL to the resized image.
